description: Format Eligian (.eligian) files with the rules of the editor and `eligian fmt`. By default this only checks: each file reports `formatted` and, when it is not, a `lineDiff` of the lines that would change; nothing is written. With `write: true` the unformatted files are rewritten in place and `written` lists their absolute paths (files already formatted are left alone and not listed). A file with syntax errors gets `error` and is never written: fix it first (`eligian_check` names the problem). `paths` takes files, directories and globs under the project root; formatting changes whitespace only, so running it twice is a no-op.
name: eligian_fmt
